Recommendation: Enable the authentication methods registration campaign (Entra ID > Authentication methods > Registration campaign) with at least one include target, so users are actively nudged to register a stronger method after completing MFA. 'Default'/unset does not reliably mean this is happening. IMPORTANT INTERACTION: per Microsoft's own registration campaign documentation, users are NOT nudged at all if their passkey profile has any of these restrictions - synced-only, device-bound-only, attestation enforced, or AAGUID key restrictions. That means enabling this campaign while PASS001 (attestation) and/or PASS002 (key restrictions) are enforced can silently nudge nobody, with no error anywhere to tell you. Microsoft additionally documents that a tenant targeting specific AAGUIDs does not get the automatic switch to passkey targeting under 'Microsoft managed' state. If both this rule and PASS001/PASS002 are Green, verify the campaign is actually reaching users before assuming registration coverage will improve on its own - and see docs/references.md for the exact wording.
